summary: Frontend-only Phase 3 verification (Home & Training clarity) for ROUJAUNE. All key acceptance criteria pass on mobile viewport (390x844) as Green Lantern rider. (1) Home renders a single [data-testid=home-notifications] region containing exactly one notice — the benchmark-reminder-banner (Ramp Test) — proving the consolidated single-highest-priority pattern. (2) BENCHMARK DOUBLE-RENDER FIX verified: only 1 of {benchmark-reminder-banner, plan-review-banner} is present at any time on Home; total page count = 1 test row / 0 review rows for this account (no FTP proposal, no today/tomorrow test). (3) 'Short on time' entry point [data-testid=short-on-time] on Today's Training tapped → navigates to /workout-list?band=short. (4) Deduped 'Start Workout' CTA on Today's Training: exactly 1 'Start Workout' textual button on the page. (5) Regression: Home, /training, /workouts, /calendar, /benchmark, /progress all render without red-screen or blank. (6) /wellness redirects to Home. (7) No 'My Peaceful Companion' / 'Recovery & Wellness' / 'Peaceful Pause' wording on Home, Training, or any regression route. (8) Coach text on Training is dynamic (Alberto for this rider, no Adriana leakage). One caveat: 'notif-more' expander could not be tested because the Green Lantern demo currently has only ONE active notification (verify email = false since user is verified, missed=0, single benchmark, no plan-update badge) — code path is correct by inspection (items.length-1 → 0 → no +N more shown).

minor.issue: Endpoint requires auth (401 without Bearer). Frontend useMissedWorkouts() fetches without waiting for auth hydration on cold-load, producing transient 401 console noise on the /login screen; response is caught silently and count stays 0. Not user-facing but pollutes console.

critical_code_review_comments: HomeNotificationArea correctly hoists the benchmark 'only' decision to the parent (testSoon → 'test' | hasReview → 'review' | else 'test') and passes it via prop, guaranteeing BenchmarkReminderBanner shows at most one of {plan-review-banner, benchmark-reminder-banner}.
BenchmarkReminderBanner respects the `only` prop but also falls back safely when omitted (time-sensitive test wins, else review, else test), keeping the standalone usage safe.
Priority order in HomeNotificationArea matches spec: verify > missed > benchmark > plan-updated.
'Short on time' Pressable on training.tsx passes `band: 'short'` via router params — matches spec exactly.
/wellness route is a hard Redirect to '/' — feature is properly removed from user-facing surfaces.
